title: Taboo Game · Deterministic Multiplayer
description: *Taboo* is an **adult party game web app** for playing the classic word-guessing game across several phones in the same room, with **no server, no rooms, and no realtime sync**. Every device reconstructs the full game state — current turn, active describer, the exact card on the table — from just a shared seed and turn number that the group agrees on verbally.

Built **100% by an AI coding agent** under my direction. The pure logic uses a **seeded mulberry32 PRNG** with **FNV-1a hashing** to pick the active player and a **single deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle** with a fixed per-turn slot budget — so **a card from a previous turn can never come back**. Each turn is a 30-second timed round where the describer races through as many words as possible; judges and guessing teammates each get a local hit counter. The 1100+ card Spanish deck — deliberately picante, political and religious for adult-party energy — was generated, deduplicated and curated by **dozens of parallel AI agents** across many themes.

All shared state lives in URL query params for one-click invites; personal info (which team, which player) stays in localStorage. The deterministic logic is **fully TDD-covered** with Bun's test runner so the game-state contract is verifiable without a browser.
